changes.reason: Restore the starting position of the same checkpointable reader after a failure before the first successful checkpoint.

kubernetes.reason: The Node host does not participate in tracking a live batch reader's starting position. The existing durable checkpoint contract still supplies completed chunk progress.
constraints: The starting position is local to the existing reader instance. A new reader starts from its configured position if there is no durable cursor.
